allow: Bash(node -e "const fs=require\('fs'\); const data=JSON.parse\(fs.readFileSync\('public/api/crafting/blueprints.json','utf8'\)\); const sample=data.slice\(0,5\); console.log\(JSON.stringify\(sample.map\(x=>\({name:x.displayName,grade:x.grade,class:x.class}\)\),null,2\)\); const withGrade=data.filter\(x=>x.grade\); const withClass=data.filter\(x=>x.class\); console.log\('total:',data.length,'withGrade:',withGrade.length,'withClass:',withClass.length\);")
